fields.mechanism: Failure to restore femoral offset contributes to instability and mechanical failure in hip arthroplasty.
fields.intervention: Incorporate patient-specific offset restoration (femoral, acetabular, and global) into hip prosthesis design and implantation protocol to match native biomechanics.
fields.expected_effect: Reduced instability and mechanical failure, thereby decreasing the incidence of explantation.
fields.falsification_test: In a cohort of hip prosthesis recipients, measure explantation rates over 5 years for devices with vs. without offset-optimized design; if no significant difference, mechanism is unsupported.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "failure to restore femoral offset has been implicated as a contributor to instability and mechanical failure"
